editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FOREX.com is a legitimate, NASDAQ-listed broker regulated by 7 authorities including NFA/CFTC (USA), FCA (UK), and ASIC (Australia). It scores 8.0/10 from NAFT in 2026 — exceptional on regulatory depth and corporate transparency, strong on instrument range (5,500+), and competitive on RAW pricing. The parent company StoneX Group (NASDAQ: SNEX) provides institutional-grade backing. US traders have almost no better option — NFA regulation eliminates most international competitors. International clients benefit from the same infrastructure with higher leverage. The 75% retail loss rate is moderate. FOREX.com works for any trader who values regulatory depth above all else, and is the definitive choice for US-based forex traders.
